sentences.text: The Switching Desk Coordinator is known operationally as Keystone.
The Switching Desk Coordinator maintains the station-wide switching plan and coordinates work across the two bay boundaries.
The Control Room Operator submits switching requests with the affected equipment, intended state changes, and requested timing.
The Switching Desk Coordinator checks each request for conflicts with active clearances and other approved work.
The Substation Supervisor resolves priority conflicts and confirms the operational authority for exceptional switching conditions.
Approved switching sequences identify the required order of actions, hold points, and conditions for stopping work.
The North Bay Controller manages control and interlocking functions assigned to the north bay under the approved sequence.
The North Bay Controller blocks a close command when its local interlocks indicate that the bay is not ready.
The South Bay Controller manages the corresponding control and interlocking functions assigned to the south bay.
The two controllers have separate equipment scopes and do not substitute for one another when executing a switching sequence.
The bay boundary defines which controller may operate each device and which indications are used to confirm its state.
Equipment shared across the boundary requires explicit coordination before a switching action can affect either bay.
The Bay Automation Controller presents bay control status while preserving the separate operating scopes of the two controllers.
The Breaker Control Unit executes permitted breaker commands only when the applicable control conditions are satisfied.
The North Protection Panel supports protection functions for the north-side equipment within its assigned scope.
The Transformer Protection Panel retains its protection authority independently of the bay switching sequence.
The Station Supervisory Control System uses the status digest to review current station operating conditions.
The Sequence Event Archive receives the Clock Drift Snapshot for event-time correlation.
The Switching Desk Coordinator produces the Isolation Boundary Card for the planned work.
The Station Gateway produces the Protocol Retry Summary for communication review.
Larkspur reviews protection coordination questions that could affect the planned switching sequence.
Bluefin provides the station time reference used to align recorded event times.
The Substation Field Crew confirms device identity and local conditions before carrying out an authorized operation.
After the Switching Desk Coordinator confirms operational handback, state-change evidence remains available for authorized engineering review.
